Yes, by the public record he did, but I can't search or read the store from here, so I can't point you to specific emails.

What I know comes from the public record (the Powers report and congressional testimony), not from the mailboxes:

- In 2000, Kaminski and his deputy Vasant Shanbhogue were asked to review the Rhythms NetConnections hedge with LJM1. They concluded the structure didn't work as a real hedge. Kaminski has said he recommended against it.
- He also raised concerns about LJM-related structures, including the Raptor vehicles that relied on Enron stock to support hedges.
- Afterward, Kaminski was reportedly pushed out of the deal-review role. Accounts say Andy Fastow's side complained, and Rick Buy in risk management told him to step back. I'm less sure of the exact sequence and dates.

For the mailboxes, I'd start with Kaminski's and Shanbhogue's, plus Rick Buy's, covering mid-2000 to 2001. Look for messages mentioning Rhythms, LJM, Raptor or the model review. I can't confirm from here that they are in the store or what they say.
